metadata.question: Was there more snow water equivalent in a 30 mile radius around Kabul, Afghanistan in February 2018 in comparison to February 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use GLDAS NOAH V2.1 SWE over a 30-mile radius around Kabul (Point[69.2075, 34.5553] buffered by 48280 m).
- Primary: NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/DA1 (daily), band SWE_inst. Periods: 2017-02-01 to 2017-03-01 and 2018-02-01 to 2018-03-01.
- Fallback: NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/M (monthly), band SWE_tavg, for the same periods. If neither has images for a period: C1.

2. Masking strategy.
- GLDAS is a model product; no cloud masking needed. Use band masks as-is. Count non-masked pixels using Reducer.count.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Valid zeros are acceptable (SWE can be 0). Use pixel count>0 as validity check. If count==0 after processing: C2.
- If any key value is null/NaN or area sum is 0: C3.
- Compare total SWE (area-weighted, i.e., sum of SWE[mm] * pixelArea) between 2018 and 2017 to decide Yes/No.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const kabul = ee.Geometry.Point([69.2075, 34.5553]);
    const radius_m = 30 * 1609.344; // 30 miles in meters
    const region = kabul.buffer(radius_m);

    const periods = [
      { label: '2017-02', start: '2017-02-01', end: '2017-03-01' },
      { label: '2018-02', start: '2018-02-01', end: '2018-03-01' }
    ];

    // 2. Dataset candidates (primary then fallback)
    const candidates = [
      { id: 'NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/DA1', band: 'SWE_inst', label: 'GLDAS V2.1 NOAH Daily (SWE_inst)' },
      { id: 'NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/M',   band: 'SWE_tavg', label: 'GLDAS V2.1 NOAH Monthly (SWE_tavg)' }
    ];

    // Helper to get collection size
    async function getSize(id, start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterDate(start, end);
      return await col.size().getInfo();
    }

    // Select a dataset that has images for both periods
    let chosen = null;
    for (const cand of candidates) {
      const s0 = await getSize(cand.id, periods[0].start, periods[0].end);
      const s1 = await getSize(cand.id, periods[1].start, periods[1].end);
      if (s0 > 0 && s1 > 0) {
        chosen = { ...cand, sizes: [s0, s1] };
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!chosen) {
      console.log('Selected dataset: None (no images in one or both periods)');
      console.log('2017-02 Images: 0');
      console.log('2018-02 Images: 0');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Region: Kabul 30mi radius, Cloud: NA`);
    console.log(`Dataset: ${chosen.label}`);
    console.log(`Scale: 25000 m`);

    // Function to compute stats for a period
    async function computeStats(start, end, label) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(chosen.id)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select([chosen.band]);
      const imgMean = col.mean().rename('SWE'); // time-mean SWE image

      // Valid pixel count
      const countDict = await imgMean.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 25000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).getInfo();
      const validCount = countDict ? countDict['SWE'] : 0;

      // Area sum
      const areaDict = await ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 25000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).getInfo();
      const area_m2 = areaDict ? areaDict['area'] : null;

      // Area-weighted total SWE (mm * m2 = liters)
      const totalDict = await imgMean.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 25000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).getInfo();
      const total_mm_m2 = totalDict ? totalDict['SWE'] : null;

      // Simple mean over region (should be close to area-weighted mean for uniform grid)
      const meanDict = await imgMean.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 25000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).getInfo();
      const mean_mm = meanDict ? meanDict['SWE'] : null;

      // Validations
      if (validCount === 0) {
        return { label, images: await col.size().getInfo(), validCount, mean_mm, totalGL: null, area_m2, status: 'C2' };
      }
      if (area_m2 === null || area_m2 === 0 || total_mm_m2 === null || mean_mm === null ||
          !isFinite(area_m2) || !isFinite(total_mm_m2) || !isFinite(mean_mm)) {
        return { label, images: await col.size().getInfo(), validCount, mean_mm, totalGL: null, area_m2, status: 'C3' };
      }

      const totalGL = total_mm_m2 / 1e9; // convert liters to gigaliters
      return { label, images: await col.size().getInfo(), validCount, mean_mm, totalGL, area_m2, status: 'OK' };
    }

    const stats2017 = await computeStats(periods[0].start, periods[0].end, periods[0].label);
    const stats2018 = await computeStats(periods[1].start, periods[1].end, periods[1].label);

    // Handle C2/C3 cases
    if (stats2017.status === 'C2' || stats2018.status === 'C2') {
      console.log(`${periods[0].label} Images: ${stats2017.images} | ValidPx: ${stats2017.validCount}`);
      console.log(`${periods[1].label} Images: ${stats2018.images} | ValidPx: ${stats2018.validCount}`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }
    if (stats2017.status === 'C3' || stats2018.status === 'C3') {
      console.log(`${periods[0].label} Images: ${stats2017.images} | Mean(mm): ${stats2017.mean_mm}`);
      console.log(`${periods[1].label} Images: ${stats2018.images} | Mean(mm): ${stats2018.mean_mm}`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`${stats2017.label}: Images=${stats2017.images}, ValidPx=${stats2017.validCount}, SWE_mean_mm=${stats2017.mean_mm.toFixed(2)}, Total_GL=${stats2017.totalGL.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`${stats2018.label}: Images=${stats2018.images}, ValidPx=${stats2018.validCount}, SWE_mean_mm=${stats2018.mean_mm.toFixed(2)}, Total_GL=${stats2018.totalGL.toFixed(2)}`);

    const dMean = stats2018.mean_mm - stats2017.mean_mm;
    const dTotal = stats2018.totalGL - stats2017.totalGL;
    const pct = (stats2017.totalGL !== 0) ? (dTotal / stats2017.totalGL) * 100.0 : null;
    const pctStr = (pct === null || !isFinite(pct)) ? 'NA' : pct.toFixed(1) + '%';
    console.log(`Δ Mean: ${dMean >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${dMean.toFixed(2)} mm, Δ Total: ${dTotal >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${dTotal.toFixed(2)} GL (${pctStr})`);

    // Final Answer: Compare totals (area-weighted)
    const answer = dTotal > 0 ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No';
    console.log(answer);

  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
